notes: Dealership prices are fictional gameplay estimates based on model families, not authenticated real-world listings or year-specific trims. Unavailable vehicle images retain temporary silhouettes until matching artwork is added. Dealership unlock requirements are authored gameplay progression levels 1-100, not specifications of real cars. Dashboard boost values are gameplay-model calibrations for representative turbo trims, not OEM pressure specifications; no boost is displayed for unconfigured powertrains. Per-vehicle audio profiles are original tuned-sound characterizations inspired by real clips; they are not exact OEM powertrain specifications or copies of copyrighted recordings. Some vehicle artwork/trim associations remain provisional. Audio mastering metadata (tone, intake, driveline, idle pulse, overrun, turbo level) are game-mix artistic calibrations for all 88 entries, not verified factory trim recordings. New gameplay entries use provisional class-based handling and pricing pending vehicle-specific tuning.
